column1: # WINDOWS FLOOR RE-MEASUREMENT — shard 03 of 8.
# The 89 admissible win32-x64 rows whose verdict is a failure or a whole-disk need
# (54 FAILS-AT-BOTH, 17 FAILS-AT-FULL-DISK, 18 NEEDS-FULL-DISK), re-run on the FIXED cell
# floor. Every one was measured on a floor with no `python`, no `python3` and no `git`,
# while the 643 Linux and macOS rows got all three free from `/usr/bin` — so their
# native-build verdicts describe the harness as much as the jail, and five packages walked
# the ladder to a WHOLE-DISK grant on `Could not find any Python installation to use`.
# The 89 are a deliberate SUPERSET of the 49-row python-at-risk subset a prior lane scoped
# by two unioned signals (a node-gyp header shelf in the unconfined arm, or gyp/python named
# in the recorded failure). That lane stated plainly that 49 is a FLOOR: a native package
# whose UNCONFINED arm also no-opped shows no shelf, which is how `registry-js` (1603 files)
# and `msnodesqlv8` (1496) were caught only by their recorded failure line. Re-running the
# whole failure population avoids resting on a detector known to under-count.
# The 54 FAILS-AT-BOTH rows additionally carry `project_cell_inert: true` — they ran the old
# `.` project spelling AND predate the terminal rung, so they get three fixes at once.
# SPECS ARE REPRODUCED EXACTLY AS THE ORIGINAL RUN WAS GIVEN THEM (a `latest` stays
# `latest`), so the floor is the variable and not the request.
# THE FIRST THREE ROWS ARE THE POSITIVE CONTROL AND THEY ARE PINNED. Each is a bare node-gyp
# compile committed as NEEDS-NOTHING on win32-x64, so each already demonstrates that node-gyp
# reaches Python and MSVC from INSIDE the jail with no grants — the one question
# `--toolchain-proof` cannot answer, since it necessarily probes from outside. If any fails
# its `no_grants` cell the host is wrong and NO row from the run may be published. They lead
# the file so each of the three slots takes one first.
# Rows are round-robined over the download-ordered population, so each shard carries a mix of
# classes rather than a block of native builds contending with each other — the shape that
# made a homogeneous control shard measure itself.
